描述_ZN: Hong Yang Cave, late Qing dynasty, on silk with color, 56 cm in length and 56 cm in width.　　Also known as "Meng Liang Steals Bones". Meng Liang was ordered by Yang Yanzhao to steal his father's bones from Hongyang Cave in Liao, but Jiao Zan followed him secretly to help him. Yang Yanzhao was so distraught at the news that he became seriously ill and died. The play is performed in Beijing Opera, Qin Opera and Han Opera. The story can be found in "The Yang Family Generals' Story".
